fact: On 16 April 2024 the head of state enrolled at DGDI for his NIP attestation of inscription in the biometric register of natural persons, the enrolment launched on 2 April 2024 for citizens aged 16 and over.
title: Etablissement de l'attestation d'inscription au registre biométrique des personnes physiques : Le Chef de l'Etat se fait enrôler
